title: Prove outbox workers, correlation telemetry and operator alerts

AC-01.expected: Required telemetry reaches approved receiver with request/release/DB-readiness/AI-gate correlation and no secret/PII leakage, or owner-approved N/A.
AC-01.actual: telemetry.ts initializes NoopTracer/NoopMeter; no exporter adapter is installed by source; OTEL settings are parsed but configuration-reference states they do not wire an exporter. Receiver approval and delivery evidence absent.

AC-02.expected: Scheduled worker execution, retry, dedupe, crash/restart and provider outage are observed; delivery succeeds only with acknowledgment.
AC-02.actual: scripts/workers/outbox.ts invokes processOutboxBatch once. No scheduler declaration in render.yaml. Retry and dedupe exist in source; no heartbeat. Handler only projects two internal approval event kinds to in-app notifications and otherwise returns; worker then marks event processed. No external channel acknowledgment or poison/dead-letter handling evidence.

AC-03.expected: Approved alert fires for controlled outage, is received/acknowledged by an authorized operator and follows approved runbook without invented threshold.
AC-03.actual: system health page says NOT APPROVED / NOT CONFIGURED; no approved receiver, numeric budget, named response owner, or delivery policy. No controlled outage/operator acknowledgment performed.
